project_type: Next.js 16 app with Drizzle ORM on Cloudflare D1 (SQLite), deployed via @opennextjs/cloudflare
build_system: npm scripts, next build for local, npx opennextjs-cloudflare build for CF
test_framework: Jest with jsdom, tests in **/__tests__/**/*.test.ts?(x), uses @testing-library/react
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run build to verify TypeScript compiles and Next.js builds successfully. 2. Run npm test to verify existing and new tests pass.
snapshot_or_generated_files: migrations/ directory contains SQL files generated by drizzle-kit generate (npm run db:generate). New migration files must be created for schema changes.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET. Node 22 available. No Cloudflare Workers runtime locally, so D1 DB is not available at build time - getCloudflareContext() will fail in tests. SSE bus is an in-memory singleton.
contribution_requirements: Enterprise-grade quality, accessible UI (ARIA, keyboard nav, contrast), all errors visible in UI never silent, build must pass before pushing.
key_patterns: API routes use NextResponse, validate with custom validators in src/lib/validation.ts, IDs generated with nanoid via src/lib/id.ts, SSE event bus in src/lib/sse.ts publishes events per party, useSSE hook for client-side SSE consumption, Drizzle schema in src/lib/schema.ts with relations, components split into host/ and guest/ directories, optimistic updates with revert on failure pattern in host components.
directory_structure: src/app/api/parties/[hostCode]/ - host API routes (menu, requests, locations, events). src/app/api/party/[guestCode]/ - guest API routes (requests, events). src/components/host/ - host UI components. src/components/guest/ - guest UI components. src/lib/ - shared utilities (db, schema, sse, validation, id). migrations/ - D1 SQL migrations.
